_note: Real user reviews, added by hand as they arrive from testers and members. Add one object per review to the 'reviews' array: { "name": "first name only", "when": "e.g. Day 30", "text": "their own words", "stars": 5 }. Leave the array empty until a real person has actually said it - never invent quotes, names or star counts. Jacques's own entry is labelled as the founder on purpose: he is a real user, and saying so plainly is what keeps the page's promise intact. Member reviews now arrive through the app (Settings > Leave a review) and live in the database, not here. The /reviews page and its structured data read from this file.

reviews.name: Jacques
reviews.text: I was addicted for 38 years. I got free at 50, and then I went looking for something to keep me there. Everything cost money I didn't have or was written by somebody who'd never done it. So I built this one — the day counter that doesn't shame you, the button for the moment it hits, a lesson a day, and someone to talk to at 2am when there's nobody to call. I use it myself. That's not marketing, that's just what happened.
